author: image
note: Seeded into /var/lib/resident/intents.db on first boot by resident-firstboot.service. Every package group, unit and policy file in the image has a row here so `resident score` starts near 0 unexplained and `why <thing>` answers from the start.

intents.text: Boot a sealed image: systemd-boot + UKI, dm-verity read-only erofs root, A/B root slots, writable /var only (mkosi.repart/, loader.conf editor=no)
Keep /etc persistently writable on a verity root via overlayfs upper on /var (resident-etc-overlay.service); image /etc is the factory state
systemd + D-Bus + polkit are the substrate that makes the agent a principal (unit management and privileges are brokered, never ambient)

The agent is a system user `agent` (uid 980) with home /var/lib/resident and groups agent,systemd-journal,adm,docker — declared in /usr/lib/sysusers.d/resident.conf, described in /etc/resident/policy.toml

polkit: agent may manage only its own units (^resident-|agentd|percept|agent-browser|shop-app), all logind power actions denied, NetworkManager mutations denied (/etc/polkit-1/rules.d/50-resident.rules)
D-Bus: agent owns org.resident.Agent and receives systemd1/login1 signals; anyone local may Ask it (/etc/dbus-1/system.d/resident.conf)
sudo: agent's only root path is /usr/lib/resident/privileged.sh (apt-get install, systemctl restart of its units), which requires RESIDENT_INTENT and logs to /var/log/resident/privileged.log
Human break-glass: openssh-server, key-only, AllowUsers owner, root locked; host keys generated on first start (/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/50-resident.conf)
Networking: systemd-networkd DHCP on en*/eth*, systemd-resolved, systemd-timesyncd (no NetworkManager in the base image)
resident tooling ships at /usr/lib/resident (agentos.py → /usr/bin/{resident,intent,why}); state in RESIDENT_HOME=/var/lib/resident; runtime deps python3, apt/dpkg, iproute2, procps, curl, jq
resident-world.timer regenerates machine.md every 10 min and records drift + failed units into the inbox (system unit, runs as agent)
resident-firstboot.service seeds this very intent log from /usr/share/resident/intents.json once, then saves the drift baseline
resident-health.service gates boot-complete.target: unhealthy boot → FailureAction=reboot → systemd-boot tries counter → fall back to the previous slot after 3 failures

agentd.service: resident Claude Agent SDK session answering /var/lib/resident/inbox events; needs /var/lib/resident/credentials/claude.env and the venv created by `resident-setup-agentd` (nodejs/npm for the Claude Code CLI)

percept.service: perception with consent — journal events in the base image, window titles/idle only with the desktop variant; titles only, 24h retention, kill switch `percept off` / consent-revoke.sh
agent-browser.service: headless Chromium with persistent profile /var/lib/resident/browser/profile (credential store, 0700), CDP on 127.0.0.1:9222, every visit logged
A/B updates via systemd-sysupdate (/usr/lib/sysupdate.d/*.transfer): UKI with +3 tries, root + verity into the _empty slot; human-triggered (update.sh), timer disabled
Persistent journal on /var (SystemMaxUse=512M) so the agent can explain yesterday
VARIANT desktop (mkosi --profile=desktop): cage + xdg-desktop-portal(-wlr) + pipewire in the agent's own lingering session, so percept sees windows and portal consent can be granted
VARIANT docker (mkosi --profile=docker): docker.io for shop-app containers; data on /var/lib/docker
